faq.q: How much does Law Offices of Robert Tsigler charge?
faq.a: Law Offices of Robert Tsigler publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee.

faq.q: Does Law Offices of Robert Tsigler offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Law Offices of Robert Tsigler does not publish a free consultation on the pages we read. That is not the same as charging for one, and it is worth asking. The intake line is published as open around the clock.

faq.q: Where does Law Offices of Robert Tsigler have offices?
faq.a: Law Offices of Robert Tsigler publishes two offices, in Manhattan and Brooklyn. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Law Offices of Robert Tsigler?
faq.a: Law Offices of Robert Tsigler names 25 attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. 10 of 25 named attorneys are currently registered and none carries an adverse status. 15 could not be told apart from namesakes in the register and are counted neither way.
